cases.title: A focus layer not drawn at its check time: one plain sentence says its crosshair won't show and to move the playhead into its bar first

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the mentor says once, in plain words, "Door isn't showing at this time, so its crosshair won't either. Move the playhead into Door's bar first." It gives no time or number, which matches the not_on_screen note and layer_bounds_reason in the tool output.

Every name the mentor uses is in the tool results: Door (proposal, focus, place_now center, middle-left), Needle (watch_offer), and the Anchor Point and Position properties. No time is mentioned that the tools didn't give.
